scope_method: Enumerate 43 structural scope declarations in seven already verified AST excerpts. Align new scope runs using neighboring named/mapped anchors: 97–111 (anchor 109), 168–172 (anchor 168, next 173), 173–183 (173, next 184), 244–250 (244/245/246/247/249), 192–193 (historical order and unchanged owner), 252 (between 251 and 253), 257–258 (both named). Validate all 18 added scope IDs and kinds; reconcile complete 260-index projection using remaining named IDs and unchanged-line anonymous starts. Full-module independent AST execution not performed.

local_call_contracts.finding: Per-view closed cache constructor initializes a fresh empty registry. Prefix visible end is minimum of prior end and boundary-1. Exact-key previous mapping lookup only when exclusive end <= dirty main. Missing/None value invokes the supplied callback; current staged map writes result. Current reversal caller supplies calculate_closed; generic callback remains conditional.

Nested MarketIndexWindow uses isinstance to flatten base offsets. Clamp left with max(0) and right with min(local length); first crossing returns None if empty; extrema invalid window raises ValueError rather than substituting a result.

Conditional dataclass replace on each main/lower row supplies local enumerate index, preserving other fields. Prepared index mode can retain un-reindexed zero-start slice. Iteration is in physical sequence order; no price arithmetic.
Dataclass field default_factory=list creates a distinct empty StopAll container per FullDirectionState instance when omitted; no lifecycle discovery at declaration.

PipelineState constructor receives directions, geometry, retained converged accepted E/StopAll, S candidates/detectors and invalid identities. StopAll map is populated only in reusable full context; fallback maps remain empty. Does not calculate visibility.

Primary context obtains opposite direction range and finalized visibility, consumes opposite primary_groups; main direction finalizes visibility before optional Primary ownership resolution and serialization. Preserve full-history groups versus published visible rows; do not infer independent opposite Primary execution from visibility call.

Only transition present and index <= selected market end replaces directions via independent reversal calculation. Pass retained live_stages and closed_regime separately. Active direction uses max segment start index with direction tie; T/F annotations applied afterwards per segment.

limitations: Exact spans for 43 excerpt scopes; other 217 scope records are source-start projections, not independently AST enumerated.
All 54 gap calls have reviewed local/conditional contracts; this does not prove arbitrary configured runtime targets.
All 589 gap integer IDs are anchored projections; independent full-module canonical replay remains unavailable.
